subject: Capacity request: QuantumForge capstone deployment — soft hold and sizing check
messages:
From: Sofia Berg <sofia@quantumforge.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@quantumforge.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request to reserve capacity for QuantumForge capstone deployment

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demos last week. We finished our internal board review and have a conditional approval to proceed with the capstone deployment. Procurement is kicking off a PO but asked that we confirm availability so we can include a realistic lead-time in the PO.

High-level ask:
- Start window: target week of 2027-10-04
- Estimated runtime: initial 12-week run then rolling production
- Baseline sizing: 24x A100 (40GB) for inference pods; peak sustained concurrent inference expected ~180 qps for 2s median latency target
- Will share final load tests next week; PO expected within 10 business days

Can you confirm whether Redwood can put a soft hold or earmark capacity pending contract close? If we need to split across regions to secure capacity, we can consider a phased cutover.

Attachments: capacity_proposal_QF_v2.pdf (proposal, sizing assumptions)

Sofia Berg
Head of Infrastructure, QuantumForge
sofia@quantumforge.ai
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Berg <sofia@quantumforge.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reserve capacity for QuantumForge capstone deployment

Sofia — thanks for the details and the deck. We're excited to get QuantumForge running. Quick clarifying questions before I loop infra formally: 

- Can you confirm whether the 24 A100s are dedicated 40GB or if 80GB variants are acceptable?
- Are you planning model parallelism or sharded weights that require specific interconnects?
- Tolerance for a staggered start? (e.g., 12 now + 12 in week 3)

I'm CC'ing Vivek to run an inventory check; Marissa will help coordinate the hold from the sales side. If procurement can share the PO target date that helps us convert soft hold -> committed reservation.

Next step: Vivek, can you run a quick availability check and recommend whether we can accommodate a soft hold for the Oct 4 window? Please include any conflicts with known near-term ramps.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Berg <sofia@quantumforge.ai>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reserve capacity for QuantumForge capstone deployment

Sofia — great news, congrats. From a GTM perspective we want to avoid being blocked on GPU availability during the deployment window. Two quick asks from our side:

1) If you can confirm the PO target date we can attach a conditional 4-week standby reservation (sales-initiated) while procurement finishes paperwork.
2) Would you accept a phased allocation (12 immediate, 12 after smoke tests) if needed? That gives us flexibility to protect runway and avoid overcommit.

Connor / Vivek — I recommend we mark this as HIGH touch and create a soft-hold in the reservation system (no billing change) once infra confirms availability. Priyom, please prep a short mutual action plan we can share with QuantumForge outlining milestones to convert the soft-hold to committed capacity.

Thanks — will escalate if we see any inventory risk.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reserve capacity for QuantumForge capstone deployment

Team — ran an initial availability check against current and near-term scheduled ramps. Summary:

Inventory snapshot (referenced): cluster_inventory_20270913.csv
- Us-west fleet: 56x A100-40GB available today (unallocated 34, soft-holds 22 across existing deals)
- Us-east fleet: 48x A100-40GB available today (unallocated 28, soft-holds 20)
- Next shipments: 32x A100-80GB arriving early Nov (can be used if QuantumForge agrees to 80GB variant)

Recommendation:
- Offer a soft-hold for 12x A100-40GB in us-west + conditional 12x in us-east to be converted to committed allocation once PO is received. This minimizes impact to existing ramps (Project Helio has a firm commitment for late Oct targeting 20 GPUs in us-west).
- If QuantumForge agrees to quantized model (8-bit) and slightly relaxed latency (2.5s median), we could reduce immediate footprint to 14 GPUs and move remaining capacity to a follow-up patch deploy.

Operational notes:
- Soft-hold will not change billing but will block offers to other sales teams. Create a ticket in OPERATIONS-RESERVE with tag deal:QF-2027-09-P-17
- If procurement turnaround exceeds 21 days, we should revisit to avoid excessive runway blocking.

Related runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/gpu-reservations

I can open the soft-hold this morning if sales approves.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Infrastructure Operations — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reserve capacity for QuantumForge capstone deployment

Quick product note on sizing trade-offs:
- If QuantumForge can run the model with INT8/8-bit quantization and use flash attention kernels, their memory footprint could drop ~40% which may allow 14x A100-40GB to meet latency targets with careful sharding.
- If they require fp16 and aggressive batching, 24x A100-40GB is the safer call.

Marissa / Connor, please ask Sofia if they're open to a short performance trade study (2 days of perf runs) vs pushing for full 24 immediately. If they agree, infra can reserve the smaller tranche and we can ramp up after perf confirmation.

Aditya Rao
Staff Product Engineer — Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Berg <sofia@quantumforge.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reserve capacity for QuantumForge capstone deployment

Sofia — looping back with our internal proposal and next steps. Per infra, we can place a soft-hold today as follows: 12x A100-40GB (us-west) + conditional 12x (us-east) pending PO. This aligns with a phased cutover and keeps Helio risk mitigated.

Proposed mutual action plan:
- Today: Redwood opens OPERATIONS-RESERVE soft-hold for 12x (no billing).
- +7 days: QuantumForge delivers PO target date and confirms 40GB vs 80GB preference.
- +10 days: Short perf run (2 days) coordinated with Aditya to validate quantization/batching tradeoffs.
- +14 days: Convert soft-hold -> committed reservation on receipt of PO; schedule production cutover.

Can you confirm acceptance of the phased plan and whether Procurement can commit to sharing the PO date within 7 business days? Once Sofia confirms, Marissa / I will ask ops to open the soft-hold ticket (OPERATIONS-RESERVE-XXXX) and attach the proposal.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
